cases.name: Kaivonni Lynn "Vonnie" Vachon
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Vonnie loved Minnie Mouse and watching Mickey Mouse Clubhouse, which was her favorite show. She loved dancing to music especially rap and R&B. She loved reading books and would say hi and wave to anybody she came across. She was a very loving, high spirited little girl who always had a smile on her face."
cases.narrative:
She died of blunt force to the abdomen, according to a probable cause affidavit written by New Haven Detective Kurtis Jeffers. Kaivonni had a torn mesentery, which is the membrane that holds intestines in place, according to a Feb. 26, 2021, autopsy.

The traumatic abdominal injury typically is caused by direct force, such as a punch to the stomach.

cases.name: Joyce Moore
cases.about:
Theresa Hicks, a friend of the victim, described Moore as someone who “never bothered anyone” and was “nice as can be.”

“She would have given the shirt off her back if you needed it more than she did,” Hicks said.

Tamra McClain, Tiffany David and Tonya Walker say their mother was a kind and loving woman. They say they don’t understand why someone would kill her like this. They say Moore was a grandmother and a great-grandmother to many.

The daughters say they will remember their mother for her overwhelming love for her children and family. They say they do not understand why someone would do this to her.
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot and killed her when she opened her front door.
